capabilities: Manage tasks with projects, labels, priorities, sub-tasks, and repeat rules
Store tasks as Markdown list items in a configurable vault data folder
Browse tasks in Inbox, Today, Upcoming, Filters, and Completed views
Show completed-task stats and a 26-week activity heatmap
Display read-only iCal calendar events inline in Today and Upcoming views
extras: Detailed documentation lives on an external docs site; the plugin explicitly adds no telemetry and requires no account. Users are advised to exclude its _belki_files/ data folder from Obsidian search and graph.
intentEvidence: A calm Todoist-like task manager for Obsidian.
problem: Checkbox-based task plugins are too lightweight and heavier task-note systems too complex, so there is no middle ground for structured task management inside a vault.

relations.evidence: belki is a Todoist-inspired task manager that lives inside your Obsidian vault.
Google Calendar, Apple/iCloud Calendar, and other HTTPS or webcal:// iCal feeds are supported

requires.name: iCal calendar feed (Google Calendar, Apple/iCloud Calendar, or other HTTPS/webcal feeds)

summary: A Todoist-inspired task manager that stores tasks as local Markdown files, with projects, sub-tasks, recurrence, labels, priorities, and calendar overlays.
